plugins.Author: Zune
plugins.Name: Master Of Puppets
plugins.Description: FFXIV plugin that lets you create and send custom actions (similar to in-game macros), either locally or via chat-based broadcast. It supports broadcasting actions to multiple clients locally, or through in-game chat channels such as Party, Linkshell, and Cross-World Linkshell. Use it to trigger custom actions like emotes, minions, mounts, fashion changes, and more.
